parameters.name: Definition
parameters.description:
The definition of the flow. It must comply with the Flow Definition Language (FDL) syntax. For forward compatibility, the system supports two versions of the flow definition specification.

> In the example flow definitions, Name: my\_flow\_name refers to the flow name and must be the same as the Name input parameter.

parameters.name: Environment
parameters.description: The environment context that the flow can access during execution.

parameters.name: ExecutionMode
parameters.description: The execution mode. This is an enumeration type. Valid values are Express and Standard. For forward compatibility, an empty string is treated as the Standard execution mode.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description:
The name of the flow. The name must be unique within the same region and cannot be changed after the flow is created. The name must meet the following requirements:

- It can contain letters (a to z and A to Z), digits (0 to 9), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

- It must start with a letter or an underscore (\_).

- It is case-sensitive.

- It must be 1 to 128 characters in length.

parameters.name: RoleArn
parameters.description: The resource descriptor for the role that the flow relies on for execution. When the flow runs, Serverless Workflow assumes this role (AssumeRole) to operate on related flow resources.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The type of the flow. The value must be **FDL**.
